summary.headline: Judgments on Parents and Siblings
summary.text: Astrological judgments on sibling conflict, the fortunes and status of fathers and mothers, and parental exaltation. The text uses Mercury–Mars hostility, the Parts of Fathers and Mother, the preceding conjunction or prevention, benefics and malefics, their signs and lords, and the fourth sign with Jupiter or the Sun.
